mastery_policy.p1_prerequisite_use: P1 prerequisite content may support readiness and recommendations, but is not proof of P3 mastery.
mastery_policy.p3_mastery_evidence: P3 mastery requires P3-aligned canonical question evidence from trainable question and mark-scheme image pairs.
mastery_policy.reporting_boundary: P3 syllabus coverage and P1 prerequisite readiness must be reported separately.

primary.qualification: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics
primary.scope_note: Primary Asterion P3 coverage target. Skills mapped here may support P3 coverage and, when mastery eligible in later phases, P3 mastery evidence.

curriculum_targets.review_source_note: Target lock based on the official Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics 9709 2026-2027 syllabus and qualification page.

supporting_prerequisites.qualification: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics
supporting_prerequisites.scope_note: Relevant P1 knowledge may appear as repair, recall, hint, or bridge support for P3 learning. P1-only success must not count as P3 syllabus coverage, P3 Guardian eligibility, P3 region rank, or P3 mastery.

skills.micro_skill_name: Find binomial terms and coefficients efficiently
State and use binomial expansion validity
Use discriminant or root conditions as evidence
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebra and functions/graphs support forming and interpreting the discriminant condition. This prerequisite repair is support-only; only reviewed clean P3 route evidence may count for mastery.

skills.micro_skill_name: Split modulus equations or inequalities into valid cases
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebra and functions/graphs support the distance and interval language used here. These notes are support-only and must not count as P3 mastery, Guardian clearance, export mastery, or candidate-promotion evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Set up partial fractions from denominator structure
Use polynomial division and remainder or factor theorem evidence
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation supports theorem substitution fluency only. Remainder and factor theorem mastery still requires reviewed P3 evidence with canonical question and mark-scheme assets.

skills.micro_skill_name: Choose algebraic structure before expanding
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation supports this repair step only. It helps students keep factors, cancellations, and excluded values visible, but it is not P3 mastery evidence or Guardian clearance evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Interpret loci and regions on an Argand diagram
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry and radians/trigonometry are support-only: plotting centres, distances, and angles prepares the locus move but does not count as P3 mastery evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Use Cartesian complex arithmetic and conjugates
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation is support-only here: students should rehearse expanding products and simplifying fractions, but only clean P3 complex-number evidence can count for mastery.

skills.micro_skill_name: Move between Cartesian and modulus-argument form
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry and radians/trigonometry are support-only: use them to check quadrant and angle work, without treating prerequisite practice as P3 complex-number mastery.

skills.micro_skill_name: Find complex powers and roots using the suitable form
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation and radians/trigonometry are support-only: exact-angle fluency helps list branches, but only reviewed P3 complex roots/powers evidence can count for mastery.

skills.micro_skill_name: Form differential equations from rate contexts
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 proportionality language, derivative notation, and basic integration are repair support only: translate the rate statement into a derivative equation before any P3 mastery claim.

skills.micro_skill_name: Apply initial conditions after integration
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic substitution and basic integration are repair support only: check that a constant of integration exists before substituting a given point.

skills.micro_skill_name: Separate variables before integrating
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 differentiation notation and basic integration rules are repair support only: rehearse rearranging dy/dx equations and integrating simple powers before counting any P3 mastery evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Apply chain, product, and quotient rules accurately
Differentiate implicit log or exponential relations
Name the differentiation method before differentiating
Differentiate parametric equations using the derivative ratio
Use derivatives for stationary points, tangents, and normals
Evaluate definite and improper integrals exactly
Choose a direct rule, substitution, parts, or algebraic rewrite
Integrate rational functions using partial fractions
Use integration by parts or substitution with correct setup
Handle log and exponential functions inside calculus questions
Convert between logarithmic and exponential form
Reject invalid logarithmic roots using domain checks
Solve exponential equations using matching bases or natural logs
Use log laws to solve logarithmic equations
Linearise logarithmic or exponential relationships
Control accuracy and rounding in numerical solutions
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 calculator accuracy and rounding conventions support this skill; they are prerequisite repair only and must not promote P3 numerical-method mastery.

skills.micro_skill_name: Apply an iteration formula consistently
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic rearrangement and function notation support reading the recurrence, but P3 mastery must come from clean iteration evidence with canonical question and mark-scheme images.

skills.micro_skill_name: Justify roots using sign changes or graph evidence
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 function-evaluation and graph-intersection ideas support the sign-change explanation only; they must not be counted as P3 mastery evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Solve trig equations over a specified interval
Choose trig identities for proof or simplification
Use quadrant discipline to find every trig solution
Rewrite a sin and cos combination in R-form
Transform reciprocal and double-angle equations safely
Translate 3D geometric conditions into vector equations
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry supports point and component handling only; modelling 3D vector conditions remains P3-only mastery evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Form and compare vector equations of lines
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry supports component comparison and simultaneous-equation fluency only; it must not count as P3 vector-line mastery evidence.

skills.micro_skill_name: Use scalar products for angles and perpendicular conditions
skills.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry supports coordinate fluency and angle awareness only; P3 mastery still requires scalar-product evidence from reviewed P3 vector questions.
